title.narrative: Strengthening civil society capacity to maintain prevention and response initiatives against GBV in the North and Northeast of Brazil

description.narrative: ThisUNFPA initiative is a joint action proposal that involves communication actions, training processes with CSOs and construction of local actions around the theme of gender-based violence. In 2020 a similar initiative was co-funded by UNFPA and the Royal Norwegian Embassy. The objective is to develop and offer an online course with the aim of promoting a safe space for dialogue with representatives of civil society, in the North and Northeast, who monitor public policies related to the ICPD Programme of Action, with an emphasis on gender equality, race, ethnicity and generation and for the prevention and response to gender-based violence, as well as developing virtual campaigns.
